scene: Inferno X — burning tombs, Farinata and Cavalcante
story: Dante and Virgil proceed among open, burning tombs in the sixth circle of Hell.
Virgil explains these sepulchers contain heretics and their lids will be closed after the Last Judgment.
Farinata degli Uberti rises upright from an open tomb and recognizes Dante's Tuscan speech.
Farinata questions Dante about his ancestors and they dispute Florentine political history.
Cavalcante, sharing the tomb, rises and asks after his son Guido; Dante's phrasing leads Cavalcante to fear Guido is dead, and he sinks back.
Farinata explains the spirits can imperfectly foresee distant events but are ignorant of the current living present unless someone reports it.
Farinata foresees Dante's exile; Dante continues with Virgil.
